main.description: Generic read-only SQL SELECT primitive (ADR-2605082000 §2 follow-up). Wraps `pymagatama.db_alchemy.sa_query` so LangGraph topology nodes can run a parameterised SELECT without per-actor py_primitive code. Strict guards: only statements starting with SELECT / WITH are accepted; INSERT / UPDATE / DELETE / DDL are rejected. For domain writes use the actor-specific MCP tool (or `tools.audit.emit` for OCEL rows).

sql.description: SELECT or WITH … SELECT statement. Single statement; trailing semicolon optional. Parameter binds via `params` (psycopg2 named-style %(key)s).

params.description: Named bind params for the SQL statement.

limit.description: Optional safety cap — if set, only the first `limit` rows are returned (server-side, after fetch). Default: 1000.
